text: in the @cart/editor/ in the mesh studio one thing im not a big fan of is this: i go to merge some faces, i turn it into glass, and then i go and turn on paint mode, the face gets a uv, and then the glass effect pretty much seems all gone, maybe it is there, its hard to really tell tho once its aquired a uv that isnt glass
resolution: Root-caused why glass faces lose their translucency when paint mode turns on: glass lives ONLY in the paint-atlas alpha channel (the transparent-pass split derives from centroid texel alpha), and every paint-side writer stomped alpha to 255 — clearAtlas (fired by Create Paint Atlas), the template/solid base fills, blendTexel (every brush dab), the flat face fills, and model_source.writeColor. Fixed by making paint own RGB and glass own alpha: user paint never touches the alpha channel, so painting a glass face now yields stained glass instead of un-glassing it; the glass toggle/colour-table apply stay the only alpha writers, and loading a saved painting re-asserts glass from the source colour table after the blit. Added a 'glass' op to the RJIT_MESHOPS harness; headless proof (glass -> detail:16 -> grouppaint -> stamp) shows the painted glass island at rgba(200,60,60,87) and opaque faces at 255. zig tests 17/17, editor builds.
